definition: Informed someone about a situation or important piece of information.
book: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
quote: But the cries and noise, and a ball which whizzed through Phileas Fogg’s hat, apprised them that the trick had been discovered.
example_sentence: Nobody apprised me that the party was fancy dress.
